text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Wooooo!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "With golden hair billowing behind her, this year's Hanshin Juvenile Fillies champion is the unparalleled beauty, Gold City!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wow… City sure is cool.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while we're hard at work training for the Hanshin J.F., Yukino Bijin requests that we watch a recording of one of Gold City's races.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I really wanna be like City—just chocked full of dazzl'n glitz and glam!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Which is why this video always gets my blood pump'n!
choice_data_list: That's the stuff! Let's give it our all today!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Roger dodger!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin is more than motivated enough to work hard. Aside from that, her surge in popularity has been begun to show subtle changes.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey there, Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: And hello to you, Trainer! ♪
choice_data_list: Hello.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is Curren Chan, one of Yukino Bijin's classmates and a wildly popular social media influencer.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hi, Curren! Did you need me for someth'n?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You guessed it! Check out this Curren-exclusive breaking news!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is that… my name in the trend'n section?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You're blowing up big-time on Umatter right now!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! But why?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Seems like your announcement about the Triple Tiara put you on everyone's radar.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Everyone wants to see you in a tiara!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Aw gee whiz!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, and just so you know, I'm one of them. ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "A country girl winning it big in the city! That's like a real #CinderellaStory!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "I'm not sure what the Triple Tiara is, but she seems strong. I'm gonna go to her race!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: This is amazing! There's so many comments… So, this is what it's like to go viral?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? This article title…
choice_data_list: What?
What?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Yukino Bijin—Superstar from the Boonies or Passing Fad?"
choice_data_list: …Can I take a look?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The article goes on to compare Yukino Bijin to a certain Umamusume who bears the title of "the Beast."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap—the so-called Beast from Kasamatsu, is an Umamusume from the countryside who's made a huge name for herself, claiming historic wins left and right.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, the article notes that Yukino Bijin and Oguri Cap are not the same. It claims Yukino Bijin's popularity comes from her looks and not her actual talent.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Whether she likes it or not, trying for the Triple Tiara means showing us what she's actually worth. Let's wait and see if Yukino Bijin will be able to prove herself"…
choice_data_list: Yukino…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: O-oh, you don't need t'worry! I'm just peachy, really!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I mean, they're not wrong. I haven't won any races yet. I'm still just gett'n started as a runner, after all.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But I'm gonna do my best. I'll put everyth'n I've got into my races and prove I'm the real deal—just like Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: All there is to it… is to do it, right?
choice_data_list: Right!
Right!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It'll take time, but the results'll speak for themselves! First things first, I've got t'sharpen my skills!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin here's rar'n to go!
choice_data_list: (She's so positive… Nothing ever gets her down.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, I've gotta get t'class! See ya!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …I'm still not good enough. 'Course I'm not.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, guess I'll just hafta be better!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Training goes smoothly for a while following that little incident… until it doesn't.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant…
choice_data_list: You okay?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: H-huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: O-oh, yes. I'm fine!
choice_data_list: Hm… You look exhausted, though…
Hm… You look exhausted, though…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, um… I s'pose you're right. I guess I pushed myself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even if she did push herself, this particular set of exercises shouldn't have drained her to this extent. She had no issues when we did these before.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um… You don't have t'worry. I'm okay, really.
choice_data_list: Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Urgh…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …I'm sorry. I'm still tuckered out from last night's train'n.
choice_data_list: Last night? Have you been training extra by yourself?
Last night? Have you been training extra by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes… I ran a mountain trail, lifted logs, and did as many uphill sprints as I could handle…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Everyone's watch'n me, but I'm nowhere near good enough t'live up to their expectations the way I am now…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I started panick'n, think'n I've gotta get good real fast if I don't wanna disappoint everyone…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I wonder if I'll ever be able t'become a glam'rous city girl like her…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It'll take time, but the results'll speak for themselves! First things first, I've got t'sharpen my skills!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though her optimism is as genuine as it gets, she always seems uncertain about her actual skills.
choice_data_list: (No wonder she's pushing herself so far past her limits.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um… Should I not've done all that?
choice_data_list: Solo training isn't intrinsically a bad thing. However…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Every training program I put together for her is designed with balance in mind. If she does extra training on top of it, she'll overexert herself.
choice_data_list: If you're worried about something, let's work it out together.
If you're worried about something, let's work it out together.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: No way that's true! I mean, it's not like y'decided on this path all by yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: If your trainer thinks y'can do it, I'm sure you'll be golden!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gee will'kers! Yukino, you big ol' dummy!
choice_data_list: Where'd that come from?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I just realized I should've come t'you for advice.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But instead, I went charg'n off on my own and made you worry…
choice_data_list: I'm sorry that I didn't notice you were feeling uneasy.
I'm sorry that I didn't notice you were feeling uneasy.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You don't have t'apologize!
choice_data_list: But there's no need to rush.
But there's no need to rush.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? There isn't?
choice_data_list: As long as you keep working, you'll be just fine.
As long as you keep working, you'll be just fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've seen what Yukino Bijin is made of, and I'm certain her talent is genuine. No matter the race or opponent, I know she'll deliver fantastic results.
choice_data_list: If anyone can turn a passing fad into a lasting legacy, it's you!
If anyone can turn a passing fad into a lasting legacy, it's you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe.
choice_data_list: What is it?
What is it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I was just think'n about everyone back home.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: How they all told me what a good runner I am and how they know everything'll turn out okay for me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hear'n that made me so happy and thankful… It warmed my heart right up.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I feel the same way right now. I can't let myself lose conf'dence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems determined, but it's not like she can flip a switch to gain confidence in herself and banish her anxiety. I try to think of what I can do to bolster her spirits more, but…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Plus, Mifuyu said I'd be fine too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mifuyu is Yukino Bijin's closest friend. I exchanged contact information with her when she came to Tokyo to wish Yukino Bijin luck before her debut.
choice_data_list: (Mifuyu, huh?)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her words hold great sway over Yukino Bijin. It'd be great if she could come and cheer her on in person…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That evening, I contact Mifuyu to ask if she'd be able to come and watch Yukino Bijin run in the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies.
